hashAlgorithm.name: SHA-256
hashAlgorithm.serialization: Recursively canonicalize every object using Object.keys(value).sort() insertion order, recursively canonicalize values, retain array order, then UTF-8 encode JSON.stringify(canonicalValue) with no trailing newline
hashAlgorithm.canonicalizationPseudocode: canonicalize(v) = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(canonicalize) : isPlainObject(v) ? Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(v).sort().map(k => [k, canonicalize(v[k])])) : v

nonMnemonicSha256.input: The complete source word object with meaningMnemonic, readingMnemonic, readingMap, and jmdictPriorityTags omitted; no other field is omitted
nonMnemonicSha256.optionalFieldRule: Only fields present in the source object are included; absent optional fields are not converted to null
nonMnemonicSha256.serializedFieldOrder: lexicographic at every object depth, as defined by canonicalizationPseudocode

packMetadataSha256.input: An array in source-file/pack order; each pack object contains id, title, description, script, levelRange (null when absent), and wordIds in source word order
packMetadataSha256.objectFieldOrder: lexicographic during serialization; the field lists above define the included data, not serialized key order

rules.kanaReadingForm: characters equals reading and an exact reb exists; an applicable sense must have no incompatible stagk and either no stagr or a matching stagr
rules.writtenReadingPair: characters exactly matches keb; reading exactly matches reb; re_nokanji must be absent; re_restr must be absent or include the keb
rules.senseApplicability: At least one sense must have no stagk/stagr restrictions or explicitly permit the exact keb/reb; applicable sense indexes are recorded without gloss text
rules.ambiguity: Multiple applicable entries are first resolved only when normalized English meanings uniquely score one entry above all others; if meanings tie for a kana surface form, a kana-only entry is preferred over a reading attached only to kanji; unresolved ties fail generation
